purpose: Film poster rights and provenance register for the HORROR AESTHETIC film database.
policy: The 48 posters currently listed in this register are original archive artworks created for HORROR AESTHETIC (including AI-assisted artwork), not scans or original theatrical posters. They are approved for display in the HORROR AESTHETIC archive and must be credited as original archive artwork. For any future third-party image, film still, fan art, scan, or externally sourced poster, verify the exact source, rights holder or creator, license/permission, attribution requirements, and reuse scope before approval; online availability alone does not grant reuse rights.
